headline: Battery storage is booming in Finland and Europe, driven by grid-scale projects, new grid-forming rules and heat storage, and Horizon Europe has battery calls opening from December 2026.
outlook_reason: European storage installations are growing fast (36 GWh in 2025, with more than 50 GWh forecast for 2026), and Finland has about 1.6 GW installed, nearly 1 GW under construction and Fingrid rules that create demand for batteries.

metrics.label: European battery storage installed in the year
metrics.value: 36 GWh (+48% YoY); cumulative fleet above 100 GWh

metrics.label: European annual installations forecast (SolarPower Europe, medium scenario)
metrics.value: over 50 GWh in 2026; 138 GWh in 2030 (28% CAGR 2026-30)

metrics.label: European storage 2026 forecast (EUPD Research, more bullish)
Utility-scale share of European storage installations
metrics.value: over 50%; residential fell to 34% from 49% in 2024

metrics.label: Finland grid-connected electricity storage (Fingrid)
metrics.value: about 1,050 MW (980 MW from 261 systems of 1 MW or more, plus about 70 MW of smaller batteries)

metrics.label: Finland battery storage capacity (Renewables Finland, via press; definition differs from Fingrid)
metrics.value: just over 1.6 GW in July; nearly 1 GW under construction; 11.9 GW planned

metrics.label: Renewable energy share of final energy consumption, Finland vs EU27

signals.title: Fu-Gen sells 100 MW Kärppiö BESS to Nala Renewables
signals.detail: Ready-to-build standalone project in Teuva, sold under a framework agreement between the two companies.

signals.title: Nala starts construction on Vuolijoki BESS; Finnish VPP launches
signals.detail: Nala issued notice to proceed on a 125 MW/250 MWh system with Sungrow batteries. Truman Data made its Energy Coop VPP, a revenue-share VPP for building batteries, available to first customers in Finland.

signals.title: Fingrid requires grid-forming support for new wind and solar in weak grids
signals.detail: Batteries sized at ±10%, ±20% or ±30% of plant capacity, depending on the area's short-circuit ratio (ESCR), can meet the requirement. This creates demand for grid-forming battery and control technology.

signals.title: Foresight acquires the 100 MW/400 MWh Nivala BESS project
signals.detail: Fully permitted, ready-to-build project in North Ostrobothnia, acquired by Foresight Energy Infrastructure Partners II.

signals.title: Delta Capacity closes financing for two Finnish batteries (250 MW/600 MWh)
signals.detail: Includes the 125 MW/300 MWh AKKU One in Lapinlahti. Shows that lenders are willing to finance merchant-exposed storage in Finland.

signals.title: EUPD Research forecasts European storage at 57 GWh in 2026
signals.detail: Forecast of +78% YoY. It is higher than SolarPower Europe's forecast of more than 50 GWh.

signals.title: SolarPower Europe's European Battery Market Outlook 2026-2030
signals.detail: Reports 36 GWh installed in 2025 and calls for an EU Battery Storage Action Plan. Dated earlier than 30 days and included as market context.

companies.name: Polar Night Energy Oy
companies.what: Tampere-based maker of sand batteries (high-temperature thermal storage). Building a 250 MWh unit for Lahti Energia in Vääksy, due summer 2027, and has a 100 MWh unit in Pornainen.

companies.name: Merus Power
companies.what: Finnish supplier of grid-forming and grid-support BESS (38 MW grid-forming system commissioned).

companies.name: Fingrid
companies.what: Transmission system operator. It sets the grid-forming requirements and runs the reserve markets that storage plays in.

companies.name: Fortum
companies.what: District heating utility with large heat pump plants using data-centre waste heat (up to 180 MW heat, 800 MWh thermal storage).

companies.name: Delta Capacity
companies.what: Battery developer that closed financing for 250 MW/600 MWh in Finland in October 2026.

companies.name: Nala Renewables
companies.what: Developer and owner building the 125 MW/250 MWh Vuolijoki BESS and buying the 100 MW Kärppiö project.

companies.name: Elisa Industriq (Gridle)
companies.what: Gridle platform used to trade and optimise Finnish batteries.

companies.name: Halide Energy
companies.what: Aalto spin-off developing copper flow batteries for long-duration storage. Funding details are from a secondhand LinkedIn report.

companies.name: Automous Oy
companies.what: Aalto deep-tech spin-off (2023) selling SaaS energy optimisation for batteries, thermal storage and P2X. Raised a €575,000 pre-seed round.

companies.name: SolarPower Europe (market reference)
companies.what: Industry association that publishes the European battery market outlook. Not a company.
